periods.time: vol-04 ch-002, one ordinary school day from morning through afternoon

name.zh: 加加美的秘密跟踪采访：黑铁珠雫篇
name.en: Kagami's Secret Tailing Interview: Shizuku Kurogane

periods.location: Hagun Academy dormitory, classrooms, cafeteria and forest training area
periods.summary: Kagami secretly follows Shizuku through a normal day and records her sleepy morning, healing role, lunch habits, online devotion to Ikki and short-sword sparring with Alice.
periods.cause: Kagami seeks daily-life material on Shizuku after profiling Stella.
periods.process: Kagami observes Shizuku waking at seven and nearly entering the dorm hallway in a revealing silk nightgown before Alice pulls her back. During classes, Kagami notes that Shizuku is class 1-4's health representative and a valuable healer, though she remains cold and solitary except around Ikki. At lunch Shizuku usually eats Japanese set meals, avoids meat and sometimes gives meat to Stella. After eating, Shizuku uses her student handbook to post in Ikki's fan thread; Kagami checks and finds she has made over one hundred replies. In the afternoon, Shizuku spars with Alice in a secluded forest and repeatedly gets back up despite being outmatched in close combat without abilities.
periods.outcome: The profile establishes Shizuku's trusted healing position, extreme brother devotion, food preferences and stubborn training effort. Alice's protective and combat-support role is also highlighted.
periods.aftermath: Shizuku's quiet diligence and resemblance to Ikki's perseverance are emphasized through Kagami's commentary.
periods.significance: Adds concrete daily-routine details for Shizuku: class health representative duties, healing value, Japanese-set-meal preference, meat avoidance, online Ikki fandom activity and persistent short-sword practice.
